translations.idiomatic: At Xilong scouts reported Wu Sangui's generals He Jizu and others holding Shimengkan in Anlong; Lebei and Maqi stormed the vanguard position, carried three peaks in turn, seized the pass, and retook Anlong.

sentences.zh: 繼祖等堅守黃草壩，列象陣以待，復與賚塔大敗之，直抵雲南城。

translations.literal: Jizu and the others held firm at Huangcaoba and drew up an elephant formation to await them; together with Laita he inflicted a great defeat on them and pressed straight to Yunnan city.
translations.idiomatic: He Jizu held Huangcaoba with elephants deployed in battle order; Lebei and Laita routed him there and marched to the gates of Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 吳世璠自殺，滇平。

translations.literal: Wu Shifan committed suicide, and Dian was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Shifan took his own life, and Yunnan was pacified.

sentences.zh: 師還，道卒。

translations.literal: The army returned, and he died on the road.
translations.idiomatic: He died on the homeward march.

sentences.zh: 佛尼埒，科奇理氏，滿洲鑲紅旗人，世居瓦爾喀。

translations.literal: Fonilie, of the Keqili clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered Red Banner whose family had long lived in Warka.
translations.idiomatic: Fonilie, of the Keqili clan, belonged to the Bordered Red Banner; his family were longtime residents of Warka.

sentences.zh: 父索爾和諾，少孤，兄瑚里納撫之成立，後為仇所害，索爾和諾手刃之，祭兄墓。

translations.literal: His father Suo'erhenuo was orphaned young; his elder brother Hulina raised him to adulthood, but was later killed by an enemy, and Suo'erhenuo killed the man with his own hand and sacrificed at his brother's tomb.
translations.idiomatic: His father Suo'erhenuo lost his parents early and was brought up by his elder brother Hulina, who was later murdered; Suo'erhenuo killed the assailant himself and offered sacrifice at his brother's grave.

sentences.zh: 崇德三年，來歸。

translations.literal: In the third year of Chongde he came and submitted.
translations.idiomatic: He submitted in the third year of Chongde.

sentences.zh: 從伐明，攻河間，戰死，授牛錄章京世職。

translations.literal: Following the campaign against Ming, he attacked Hejian, died in battle, and was granted the hereditary rank of company commander.
translations.idiomatic: He joined the expedition against Ming, fell attacking Hejian, and was posthumously granted the hereditary company commandership.

sentences.zh: 佛尼埒襲職。

translations.literal: Fonilie inherited the office.
translations.idiomatic: Fonilie succeeded to the family post.

sentences.zh: 授西安駐防牛錄額真，進二等阿達哈哈番。

translations.literal: He was appointed company commander of the Xi'an garrison and advanced to second-class deputy commandant.
translations.idiomatic: He became company commander of the Xi'an garrison and was raised to second-class deputy commandant.

sentences.zh: 康熙初，累擢西安副都統。

translations.literal: In the early Kangxi years he was promoted step by step to Xi'an deputy lieutenant-general.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Kangxi reign he rose to deputy lieutenant-general at Xi'an.

sentences.zh: 十三年春，從將軍瓦爾喀道四川討吳三桂。

translations.literal: In the spring of the thirteenth year he followed General Warka by the Sichuan route to suppress Wu Sangui.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the thirteenth year he marched under General Warka into Sichuan against Wu Sangui.

sentences.zh: 入棧道，聞四川叛附三桂，譚弘據陽平關。

translations.literal: Entering the plank-road country, he learned that Sichuan had rebelled and joined Wu Sangui, and that Tan Hong held Yangping Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On the plank roads he heard that Sichuan had gone over to Wu Sangui and that Tan Hong held Yangping Pass.

sentences.zh: 從瓦爾喀自野狐嶺進兵，斬三千餘級。

translations.literal: Following Warka he advanced from Yehuling and took more than three thousand heads.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Warka through Yehuling and took more than three thousand heads.

sentences.zh: 進朝天關，屢擊敗敵軍。

translations.literal: Advancing to Chaotian Pass, he repeatedly defeated the enemy army.
translations.idiomatic: At Chaotian Pass he beat back the enemy again and again.

sentences.zh: 總兵吳之茂以保寧叛，移師往討之，弗克，鑿壕塹與相持。

translations.literal: Brigade-general Wu Zhimao rebelled from Baoning; he moved his army to suppress him, failed to take the place, and dug trenches to stand in stalemate.
translations.idiomatic: When brigade-general Wu Zhimao rebelled at Baoning, Fonilie moved against him, failed to reduce the city, and settled into trench warfare.

sentences.zh: 之茂出劫略陽糧艘，截槐樹驛運道。

translations.literal: Zhimao came out to raid grain boats at Lueyang and cut the transport route at Huaishu Post.
translations.idiomatic: Zhimao sallied forth to seize grain boats on the Lueyang route and severed the supply line at Huaishu Post.

sentences.zh: 我師餉不繼，還漢中。

translations.literal: Our army's provisions failed, and they returned to Hanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: With rations exhausted, the army withdrew to Hanzhong.

sentences.zh: 之茂要於中途，與總兵王懷忠擊之，敗走。

translations.literal: Zhimao waylaid them on the road; together with brigade-general Wang Huaizhong they struck him, and he was defeated and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Zhimao ambushed the column on the march; Fonilie and brigade-general Wang Huaizhong routed him and drove him off.

sentences.zh: 其冬，提督王輔臣叛，連陷平涼、秦州。

translations.literal: That winter Regional Commander Wang Fuchen rebelled and in succession took Pingliang and Qinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: That winter Wang Fuchen, regional commander of Shaanxi, rebelled and swept Pingliang and Qinzhou.

sentences.zh: 十四年，擢西安將軍，加振武將軍銜。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year he was promoted to Xi'an general and given the nominal rank of General Who Shakes Martial prowess.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year he was made Xi'an general with the honorary title General Who Shakes Martial prowess.

sentences.zh: 命與貝勒洞鄂進討輔臣將高鼎，以四千人屯關山河岸，偕穆佔整師與戰，破其壘；

translations.literal: He was ordered to advance with Prince Beile Tonge against Fuchen's general Gao Ding, encamped four thousand men on the banks of the Guanshan River, and together with Muzhan rallied the army for battle and stormed their fort;
translations.idiomatic: With Prince Beile Tonge he was sent against Fuchen's general Gao Ding, posted four thousand men on the Guanshan River, and with Muzhan smashed the rebel fort;

sentences.zh: 逐北，又敗之渭河橋，進薄秦州。

translations.literal: pursuing the fleeing enemy, he again defeated them at Weihe Bridge and pressed close to Qinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: pursued them north, routed them again at Weihe Bridge, and closed on Qinzhou.

sentences.zh: 壘未定，賊乘我不備，開壁出戰。

translations.literal: Before the fortifications were finished the bandits, catching our forces unprepared, opened the walls and sallied out to fight.
translations.idiomatic: While the entrenchments were still incomplete, the rebels caught the army off guard and sallied from the walls.

sentences.zh: 佛尼埒督軍遮擊，賊不敢犯。

translations.literal: Fonilie directed the army in intercepting the attack, and the bandits did not dare press the assault.
translations.idiomatic: Fonilie led a blocking counterattack and the rebels dared not press home.

sentences.zh: 旋攻克東西二關。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward he captured the eastern and western passes.
translations.idiomatic: He soon took the eastern and western passes as well.

sentences.zh: 賊數千掠仙逸關，佛尼埒慮斷餉道，分兵往援。

translations.literal: Several thousand bandits raided Xianyi Pass; fearing the supply route would be cut, Fonilie detached troops to relieve it.
translations.idiomatic: When several thousand rebels struck Xianyi Pass, Fonilie, fearing for his supply line, sent a detachment to its aid.

sentences.zh: 賊逾山走，追躡之，殺其黨且盡，遂率師趨隴州。

translations.literal: The bandits fled over the mountains; he pursued and hunted them down, killing nearly all their followers, then led the army toward Longzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels fled over the hills; he ran them down and killed nearly every man, then marched on Longzhou.

sentences.zh: 賊縱火焚山澤，佛尼埒曰：「是欲燒絕我輓運道也。

translations.literal: The bandits set fires to burn the hills and marshes; Fonilie said: "This is meant to burn out our transport route.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels torched the hills and marshland; Fonilie said, "They mean to burn out our supply route.

sentences.zh: 若不增兵策應，軍食何賴焉？

translations.literal: If we do not increase our troops and coordinate relief, on what shall the army's food rely?"
translations.idiomatic: Unless we bring up more men to cover the convoys, what will feed this army?"

sentences.zh: 」因暫駐隴州。

translations.literal: Therefore he temporarily encamped at Longzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He therefore halted temporarily at Longzhou.

sentences.zh: 時師攻秦州久未下，而四川及平涼諸寇挾萬餘人赴救，城寇與應者亦八千餘。

translations.literal: At that time the army had long besieged Qinzhou without taking it, while bandits from Sichuan and Pingliang brought more than ten thousand men to the relief, and those inside the city who answered them numbered more than eight thousand.
translations.idiomatic: The siege of Qinzhou had dragged on when more than ten thousand rebels from Sichuan and Pingliang marched to its relief, joined inside the walls by eight thousand more.

sentences.zh: 佛尼埒亟還師與諸軍合，偕內大臣坤連敗賊眾，擒其將李國棟等，殪其眾三千餘。

translations.literal: Fonilie hurriedly brought his army back and joined the other forces; together with Inner Minister Kun he repeatedly defeated the rebel masses, captured their generals Li Guodong and others, and killed more than three thousand of their men.
translations.idiomatic: Fonilie raced back to join the main force; he and Inner Minister Kun broke the rebel host again and again, captured Li Guodong and other commanders, and killed more than three thousand men.

sentences.zh: 州城复，以次下禮縣、西和、清水、伏羌諸城。

translations.literal: Qinzhou was recovered, and in succession they took the cities of Li County, Xihe, Qingshui, and Fuqiang.
translations.idiomatic: Qinzhou fell, and Li County, Xihe, Qingshui, and Fuqiang followed in turn.

sentences.zh: 漢中運道阻，軍大饑。

translations.literal: The Hanzhong transport route was blocked, and the army suffered great hunger.
translations.idiomatic: With the Hanzhong route cut, the army went hungry.

sentences.zh: 將軍席卜臣還西安，上命佛尼埒領兵開棧道，規漢中，緣塗擊賊，皆潰竄。

translations.literal: General Xibochen returned to Xi'an; the emperor ordered Fonilie to lead troops to open the plank roads and strike for Hanzhong, and along the way he struck the bandits and they all broke and fled.
translations.idiomatic: When Xibochen withdrew to Xi'an, the emperor ordered Fonilie to reopen the plank roads toward Hanzhong; rebels along the route broke and scattered at every encounter.

sentences.zh: 十五年，之茂欲為輔臣援，再犯秦州。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year Zhimao sought to aid Fuchen and again invaded Qinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year Wu Zhimao, intending to relieve Fuchen, struck Qinzhou again.

sentences.zh: 佛尼埒與護軍統領傑殷議繞賊後，絕其運道，復靜寧。

translations.literal: Fonilie and Guard Commander Jieyin planned to circle behind the bandits, cut their transport route, and recover Jingning.
translations.idiomatic: Fonilie and Guard Commander Jieyin planned a sweep behind the enemy to cut his supply line and retook Jingning.

sentences.zh: 大將軍圖海下平涼，之茂遁。

translations.literal: Grand General Tu Hai descended on Pingliang, and Zhimao fled.
translations.idiomatic: Grand General Tu Hai reduced Pingliang, and Wu Zhimao fled.

sentences.zh: 又與傑殷乘夜追擊，及之牡丹園，遂克祁山堡。

translations.literal: Together with Jieyin he pursued by night, caught them at Mudan Garden, and thereupon took Qishan Fort.
translations.idiomatic: With Jieyin he gave night pursuit, ran the enemy down at Mudan Garden, and took Qishan Fort.

sentences.zh: 之茂僅以十餘騎走。

translations.literal: Zhimao escaped with barely more than ten horsemen.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Zhimao escaped with only a dozen horsemen.

sentences.zh: 十六年，追論自保寧退還漢中諸罪，降世職為拜他喇布勒哈番，削振武將軍銜，仍署西安將軍。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year his offenses in withdrawing from Baoning back to Hanzhong were reviewed after the fact; his hereditary rank was reduced to deputy company commander, the General Who Shakes Martial prowess title was stripped, and he still acted as Xi'an general.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year the court revisited his retreat from Baoning to Hanzhong, lowered his hereditary rank to deputy company commander, removed his General Who Shakes Martial prowess title, and left him acting Xi'an general.

sentences.zh: 十七年，與吳丹等敗敵於牛頭山、於香泉，率師駐守寶雞，堅扼棧道諸隘。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, together with Wu Dan and others he defeated the enemy at Niutou Mountain and at Xiangquan, led his army to garrison Baoji, and firmly held the passes of the plank roads.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year he and Wu Dan routed the enemy at Niutou Mountain and Xiangquan, garrisoned Baoji, and locked down the plank-road passes.

sentences.zh: 寇屢至，屢敗之。

translations.literal: Bandits came repeatedly, and he repeatedly defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Raiders came again and again, and he turned them back every time.

sentences.zh: 十八年，從大將軍圖海徵興安，寇阻梁河關。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year he followed Grand General Tu Hai in the campaign against Xing'an; bandits blocked Lianghe Pass.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year he followed Tu Hai against Xing'an, where rebels held Lianghe Pass.

sentences.zh: 佛尼埒領兵先驅，濟乾玉河，拔之。

translations.literal: Fonilie led the army as vanguard, crossed the Qianyu River, and took it.
translations.idiomatic: Fonilie led the van, crossed the Qianyu River, and stormed the pass.

sentences.zh: 興安下。

translations.literal: Xing'an fell.
translations.idiomatic: Xing'an was recovered.

sentences.zh: 十九年，潼川降，並復鹽亭、中江、射洪諸縣。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year Tongchuan surrendered, and the counties of Yanting, Zhongjiang, and Shehong were also recovered.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year Tongchuan submitted and Yanting, Zhongjiang, and Shehong were retaken as well.

sentences.zh: 再敗寇豹子山，克瀘州。

translations.literal: He again defeated bandits at Baozishan and took Luzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He routed the enemy again at Baozishan and captured Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 冬，吳世璠將胡國柱自敘州擾永寧，詔授建威將軍討之。

translations.literal: In winter Wu Shifan's general Hu Guozhu from Xuzhou harried Yongning; an edict appointed Fonilie General Who Establishes Might to suppress him.
translations.idiomatic: That winter Wu Shifan's general Hu Guozhu raided Yongning from Xuzhou; Fonilie was named General Who Establishes Might and sent against him.

sentences.zh: 二十年，克馬湖。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year he took Mahu.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year he captured Mahu.

sentences.zh: 世璠將宋國輔等以永寧降。

translations.literal: Wu Shifan's generals Song Guofu and others surrendered Yongning.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Shifan's generals Song Guofu and others handed over Yongning.

sentences.zh: 國柱亦棄敘州遁，上命佛尼埒守之。

translations.literal: Guozhu also abandoned Xuzhou and fled; the emperor ordered Fonilie to garrison it.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Guozhu abandoned Xuzhou and fled; the emperor left Fonilie to hold the city.

sentences.zh: 尋命還鎮漢中。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward he was ordered to return and garrison Hanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon ordered back to his post at Hanzhong.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，卒。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the twenty-first year.

sentences.zh: 乾隆初，追諡恭靖。

translations.literal: In the early Qianlong years he was posthumously enfeoffed as Gongjing.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Qianlong reign he received the posthumous name Gongjing.

sentences.zh: 子托留，襲世職，官至黑龍江將軍。

translations.literal: His son Tuoliu inherited the hereditary office and rose to Heilongjiang general.
translations.idiomatic: His son Tuoliu succeeded to the family rank and eventually became Heilongjiang general.

sentences.zh: 額倫特，別有傳。

translations.literal: E'lente has a separate biography.
translations.idiomatic: E'lente is treated in a separate biography.

sentences.zh: 坤，那木都魯氏，滿洲正黃旗人，先世居綏芬，隸瓦爾喀部。

translations.literal: Kun, of the Namuduru clan, was a Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner; his forebears had lived at Suifen and belonged to the Warka tribe.
translations.idiomatic: Kun, of the Namuduru clan, belonged to the Plain Yellow Banner; his family were longtime residents of Suifen in the Warka lands.

sentences.zh: 父伊訥克，太宗伐瓦爾喀，先眾降。

translations.literal: His father Yin'eke, when the Taizong campaigned against Warka, submitted ahead of the rest.
translations.idiomatic: His father Yin'eke submitted before the other Warka chiefs when the Taizong marched against them.

sentences.zh: 坤事太宗，洊擢一等侍衛，兼管牛錄事。

translations.literal: Kun served the Taizong, was repeatedly promoted to first-class bodyguard, and concurrently managed company affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Serving under the Taizong, Kun rose to first-class imperial guard and also managed his company.

sentences.zh: 太宗伐明，圍松山。

translations.literal: When the Taizong campaigned against Ming he besieged Songshan.
translations.idiomatic: On the Taizong's expedition against Ming he helped besiege Songshan.

sentences.zh: 明總兵曹變蛟乘夜犯御營，迫正黃旗營門。

translations.literal: Ming brigade-general Cao Bianjiao attacked the imperial camp by night and pressed up to the gate of the Plain Yellow Banner encampment.
translations.idiomatic: Ming brigade-general Cao Bianjiao struck the imperial camp by night and drove to the gates of the Plain Yellow Banner lines.

sentences.zh: 諸侍衛及親軍等皆散列門左右，坤獨當門，力戰卻敵。

translations.literal: The various bodyguards and personal troops all deployed scattered to left and right of the gate; Kun alone faced the gate and fought hard, repelling the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: Bodyguards and personal troops lined both sides of the gate; Kun alone held the entrance and fought fiercely until the enemy was driven back.

sentences.zh: 上嘉其勇，賜號「巴圖魯」，賚白金四百，授一等甲喇章京世職。

translations.literal: The emperor praised his courage, bestowed the title "baturu," rewarded four hundred taels of white silver, and appointed him first-class company commander as a hereditary office.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised his bravery, gave him the title baturu, awarded four hundred taels of silver, and granted a hereditary first-class company commandership.

sentences.zh: 世祖朝，累進一等阿思哈尼哈番兼拖沙喇哈番。

translations.literal: During the Shizu reign he was repeatedly advanced to first-class commandant-in-chief with concurrent hereditary captain.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Shizu Emperor he rose in stages to first-class commandant-in-chief and hereditary captain.

sentences.zh: 尋以遣祭昭陵辭未往，扈蹕南台不入直，又娶女子已賜配者為妻，論罪當死，上寬之，奪官，仍留世職侍衛。

translations.literal: Soon, for declining when dispatched to sacrifice at the Zhaoling Mausoleum yet not going, for attending the emperor at the Southern Terrace but not entering regular duty, and for taking as wife a woman already granted in marriage to another, he was judged guilty and deserving death; the emperor was lenient, stripped his office, but still retained him as a hereditary bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly afterward he was found guilty on three counts—declining a mission to sacrifice at the Zhaoling Mausoleum yet never going, escorting the emperor to the Southern Terrace without taking regular duty, and marrying a woman who had already been given as a bride to another. The offense carried the death penalty, but the emperor showed mercy, removed his office, and left him a hereditary guardsman's post.

sentences.zh: 順治十一年，從靖南將軍珠瑪喇下廣東，命署固山額真。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Shunzhi he followed General Who Pacifies the South Zhumala south to Guangdong and was ordered to act as banner commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year of Shunzhi he marched into Guangdong under General Who Pacifies the South Zhumala and was appointed acting banner commander.

sentences.zh: 破明將李定國於新會，逐至橫州江岸，斬馘無算。

translations.literal: He defeated the Ming general Li Dingguo at Xinhui, pursued him to the bank of the river at Hengzhou, and cut off heads beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: He broke Li Dingguo at Xinhui, chased him to the Hengzhou riverbank, and killed an untold number of his men.

sentences.zh: 擢內大臣。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Inner Minister.
translations.idiomatic: He was raised to Inner Minister.

sentences.zh: 康熙十二年，獎先朝諸舊臣，坤加太子太保。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Kangxi, as former ministers of the prior reign were rewarded, Kun was given Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year of Kangxi, when veterans of the founding reign were honored, Kun was made Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 吳三桂反，授振武將軍，帥師駐汝寧。

translations.literal: When Wu Sangui rebelled, he was appointed General Who Shakes Martial prowess and commanded troops stationed at Runing.
translations.idiomatic: When Wu Sangui rose in rebellion, he was named General Who Shakes Martial prowess and encamped at Runing.

sentences.zh: 王輔臣叛，命移師西安。

translations.literal: When Wang Fuchen rebelled, he was ordered to shift his army to Xi'an.
translations.idiomatic: After Wang Fuchen rebelled he was ordered to march west to Xi'an.

sentences.zh: 十四年，又命偕副都統翁愛等進駐漢中，輔臣毀鳳縣偏橋絕運道，又斷棧道，阻漢中聲援。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year he was again ordered to advance with Assistant Commander-in-Chief Weng Ai and others to garrison Hanzhong; Fuchen destroyed the Pian Bridge in Feng County, cutting the supply route, and also severed the plank road, blocking reinforcements to Hanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year he was sent with Assistant Commander-in-Chief Weng Ai and others to take Hanzhong. Fuchen destroyed the Pian Bridge at Feng County to cut supply lines and broke the plank roads, isolating Hanzhong from outside support.

sentences.zh: 詔趣坤援漢中，次寶雞，以道阻未克進。

translations.literal: An edict urged Kun to relieve Hanzhong; he halted at Baoji but could not advance because the road was blocked.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Kun to relieve Hanzhong. He reached Baoji but could not push forward because the route was blocked.

sentences.zh: 命罷將軍，以內大臣從軍。

translations.literal: He was ordered to relinquish the generalship and serve in the army as Inner Minister.
translations.idiomatic: He was removed as general and continued in the field as Inner Minister.

sentences.zh: 秦州既复，朝議規复漢中，以坤守潼關。

translations.literal: Once Qinzhou had been recovered, court deliberation planned recovery of Hanzhong and assigned Kun to guard Tongguan.
translations.idiomatic: After Qinzhou was retaken the court planned to recover Hanzhong and posted Kun at Tongguan.

sentences.zh: 十八年，上念坤已老，召還。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year the emperor, mindful that Kun was already old, summoned him back.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year, considering Kun's age, the emperor recalled him.

sentences.zh: 追論漢中逗留狀，當奪官、削巴圖魯號。

translations.literal: His delay at Hanzhong was reviewed after the fact; he deserved to be stripped of office and the baturu title removed.
translations.idiomatic: A retroactive review of his delay at Hanzhong held that he should lose his rank and forfeit the baturu title.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「巴圖魯號太宗所賜，其勿削！

translations.literal: The emperor said, "The baturu title was bestowed by the Taizong — do not strip it!
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "The baturu title came from the Taizong; leave it!

sentences.zh: 但奪官。

translations.literal: Only strip his office.
translations.idiomatic: Strip only his office.

sentences.zh: 」仍留一等阿達哈哈番世職。

translations.literal: " He was still retained with the hereditary office of first-class commandant.
translations.idiomatic: " He kept his hereditary first-class commandant's rank.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，授散秩大臣，並諭年衰不能朝，聽家居。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year he was appointed minister without portfolio and was also told that, as he was aged and unable to attend court, he was permitted to live at home.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year he became a minister without portfolio; noting his age and inability to attend court, the emperor allowed him to remain at home.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，卒。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the twenty-sixth year.

sentences.zh: 鄂泰，瓜爾佳氏，滿洲正白旗人，世居蘇完。

translations.literal: Etai, of the Guwalgiya clan, was a Manchu of the Plain White Banner; his family had long lived at Suwan.
translations.idiomatic: Etai of the Guwalgiya clan belonged to the Plain White Banner; his family had been established at Suwan for generations.

sentences.zh: 國初來歸，以軍功累進二等阿達哈哈番。

translations.literal: In the founding of the dynasty he came over and submitted; through military merit he was repeatedly advanced to second-class commandant.
translations.idiomatic: He submitted when the dynasty was founded and rose through battle honors to second-class commandant.

sentences.zh: 順治間，授盛京禮部理事官，坐事黜，並奪世職，旋復起。

translations.literal: During Shunzhi he was appointed administrative officer of the Mukden Board of Rites; for an offense he was dismissed and also stripped of his hereditary office, but was soon reinstated.
translations.idiomatic: Under Shunzhi he became an administrative officer in the Mukden Board of Rites, was dismissed for misconduct and lost his hereditary rank, but was soon brought back into service.

sentences.zh: 康熙初，洊擢盛京副都統。

translations.literal: In the early Kangxi years he was repeatedly promoted to Deputy Commander-in-Chief of Mukden.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Kangxi he was promoted to Mukden deputy commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 王輔臣叛，大將軍貝勒洞鄂西討，命鄂泰率盛京兵千來京備徵發。

translations.literal: When Wang Fuchen rebelled, Grand General Prince Beile Tonge marched west to suppress him; Etai was ordered to lead a thousand Mukden troops to the capital in preparation for mobilization.
translations.idiomatic: When Wang Fuchen rebelled, Grand General Prince Beile Tonge marched west against him, and Etai was told to bring a thousand Mukden troops to the capital for deployment.

sentences.zh: 十四年，授建威將軍，率所部兵駐太原。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year he was appointed General Who Establishes Might and led his troops to garrison Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year he was made General Who Establishes Might and posted his men at Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 尋命赴西安參贊洞鄂軍務，以建威將軍印授副都統吳丹。

translations.literal: Soon he was ordered to go to Xi'an to assist in Tonge's military affairs; the seal of General Who Establishes Might was transferred to Assistant Commander-in-Chief Wu Dan.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon sent to Xi'an to assist Tonge and surrendered the General Who Establishes Might seal to Assistant Commander-in-Chief Wu Dan.

sentences.zh: 鄂泰與副都統阿爾瑚屯寶雞，賊出棧道攻九龍山，鄂泰督兵縱擊，盡殪之。

translations.literal: Etai and Assistant Commander-in-Chief A'erhu encamped at Baoji; the rebels came out of the plank road and attacked Jiulong Mountain; Etai directed the troops in a full pursuit and slaughtered them all.
translations.idiomatic: Etai and Assistant Commander-in-Chief A'erhu held Baoji. When rebels came down the plank road against Jiulong Mountain, Etai led a counterattack and wiped them out.

sentences.zh: 輔臣所署置總兵任德望率兵及倮倮七千餘屯益門鎮，鄂泰分兵九路進擊，自巳至未，破七壘。

translations.literal: Ren Dewang, a brigade-general appointed by Fuchen, led troops and more than seven thousand Luo tribesmen encamped at Yimen Town; Etai divided his force into nine columns and attacked, from the si hour to the wei hour breaking seven fortified camps.
translations.idiomatic: Fuchen's appointee Ren Dewang held Yimen Town with his own troops and some seven thousand Luo auxiliaries. Etai attacked on nine fronts from midmorning until dusk and overran seven camps.

sentences.zh: 德望以百騎遁，驍騎校韓楚漢射中其股，乃降。

translations.literal: Dewang fled with a hundred horsemen; Bold Cavalry Captain Han Chuhan shot him in the thigh, whereupon he surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Dewang fled with a hundred riders, but Bold Cavalry Captain Han Chuhan shot him in the thigh and brought about his surrender.

sentences.zh: 十五年，复捕餘賊紅崖堡。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year he again captured remnant rebels at Hongya Fort.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year he mopped up remaining rebels at Hongya Fort.

sentences.zh: 十八年，卒，追授拜他喇布勒哈番兼拖沙喇哈番。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year he died; posthumously he was granted deputy company commander with concurrent hereditary captain.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the eighteenth year and was posthumously made deputy company commander and hereditary captain.

sentences.zh: 吳丹，納喇氏，滿洲正黃旗人，葉赫金台石曾孫也。

translations.literal: Wu Dan, of the Nara clan, was a Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner; he was a great-grandson of Jintaiji of Yehe.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Dan of the Nara clan belonged to the Plain Yellow Banner and was a great-grandson of Yehe's Jintaiji.

sentences.zh: 康熙初，以一等侍衛同學士郭廷祚視淮安河決。

translations.literal: In the early Kangxi years, as a first-class bodyguard he joined Academician Guo Tingzuo in inspecting the Huai'an river breach.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Kangxi he served as first-class bodyguard alongside Academician Guo Tingzuo to inspect the Huai'an flood breach.

sentences.zh: 十三年，大將軍順承郡王勒爾錦討吳三桂，吳丹奉使軍中，宣諭機宜。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year Grand General the Prince of Jingcheng Le'erjin campaigned against Wu Sangui; Wu Dan was sent on mission to the army to proclaim the strategic plan.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year Grand General Prince of Jingcheng Le'erjin marched against Wu Sangui, and Wu Dan was dispatched to the front to announce the emperor's strategy.

sentences.zh: 王輔臣叛，命署副都統，從鄂泰駐太原。

translations.literal: When Wang Fuchen rebelled he was ordered to act as assistant commander-in-chief and followed Etai to garrison Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: When Wang Fuchen rebelled he was appointed acting assistant commander-in-chief and served under Etai at Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 旋復命署建威將軍，移師潼關。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward he was again ordered to act as General Who Establishes Might and shifted his army to Tongguan.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon named acting General Who Establishes Might and moved his forces to Tongguan.

sentences.zh: 十五年，從大將軍圖海徵平涼，擊賊虎山墩，輔臣乞降，吳丹率數騎入城，安撫降人。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year he followed Grand General Tu Hai to campaign at Pingliang, attacked the rebel position at Hushan Dun; Fuchen begged to surrender; Wu Dan led several horsemen into the city and pacified those who submitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year he joined Grand General Tu Hai against Pingliang, stormed the rebel redoubt at Hushan Dun, and when Fuchen sued for peace entered the city with a handful of riders to pacify the surrendered.

sentences.zh: 十七年，授護軍統領。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year he was appointed commander of the Guard.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year he became commander of the Guard.

sentences.zh: 時漢中、興安尚為三桂兵所據，上趣圖海進軍，以吳丹參贊軍務，戰於牛頭山、香泉，屢破賊。

translations.literal: At the time Hanzhong and Xing'an were still held by Wu Sangui's troops; the emperor urged Tu Hai to advance; Wu Dan assisted in military affairs; fighting at Niutou Mountain and Xiangquan, he repeatedly defeated the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Hanzhong and Xing'an were still in rebel hands; as the emperor pressed Tu Hai forward, Wu Dan assisted in the campaign and won repeated victories at Niutou Mountain and Xiangquan.

sentences.zh: 圖海入覲，命仍佩建威將軍印，暫統大兵。

translations.literal: Tu Hai came to audience; he was ordered still to wear the seal of General Who Establishes Might and temporarily command the main army.
translations.idiomatic: When Tu Hai went to court he was told to keep the General Who Establishes Might seal and hold interim command of the main force.

sentences.zh: 旋從圖海徇鎮安，偕將軍佛尼埒戰於火神崖，破賊，渡乾玉河，克梁河關，遂復興安。

translations.literal: Soon he followed Tu Hai to march on Zhen'an, together with General Fonilie fought at Huoshen Cliff, defeated the rebels, crossed the Ganyu River, took Lianghe Pass, and thus recovered Xing'an.
translations.idiomatic: He then followed Tu Hai into Zhen'an, fought alongside General Fonilie at Huoshen Cliff, crossed the Ganyu River, captured Lianghe Pass, and recovered Xing'an.

sentences.zh: 上命圖海還駐鳳翔，分兵畀吳丹，與將軍王進寶下四川，為後繼。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Tu Hai to return and garrison Fengxiang, divided troops and gave them to Wu Dan, and together with General Wang Jinbao descended into Sichuan as the rear echelon.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor recalled Tu Hai to Fengxiang, detached a contingent for Wu Dan, and sent him into Sichuan with General Wang Jinbao as the follow-up force.

sentences.zh: 十九年，與進寶擊賊蟠龍、錦屏諸山，大破之，遂復保寧，獲三桂將吳之茂等。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year, together with Jinbao he attacked rebels at Panlong, Jinping, and other mountains, thoroughly defeated them, recovered Baoning, and captured Wu Sangui's general Wu Zhimao and others.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year he and Jinbao smashed the rebels on Panlong, Jinping, and neighboring heights, retook Baoning, and captured Wu Sangui's commanders Wu Zhimao and others.

sentences.zh: 時將軍趙良棟亦復成都，吳丹與佛尼埒分兵取順慶、重慶，並下達州、東鄉、太平諸州縣。

translations.literal: At the time General Zhao Liangdong also recovered Chengdu; Wu Dan and Fonilie divided their forces to take Shunqing and Chongqing, and also captured the prefectures and counties of Dazhou, Dongxiang, and Taiping.
translations.idiomatic: While General Zhao Liangdong retook Chengdu, Wu Dan and Fonilie split their forces to seize Shunqing and Chongqing and bring Dazhou, Dongxiang, Taiping, and other districts under control.

sentences.zh: 詔取瀘州，趨雲南。

translations.literal: An edict ordered capture of Luzhou and advance toward Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: An edict called for taking Luzhou and pressing on toward Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 吳丹復從佛尼埒戰於豹子山，破瀘州賊。

translations.literal: Wu Dan again followed Fonilie to fight at Baozi Mountain and defeated the Luzhou rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Dan again fought under Fonilie at Baozi Mountain and routed the Luzhou rebels.

sentences.zh: 會永寧復為賊得，仁懷亦不守，良棟劾吳丹不急赴援，解將軍印還漢中。

translations.literal: At the time Yongning was again taken by rebels and Renhuai also could not be held; Liangdong impeached Wu Dan for not hurrying to the relief; he was relieved of the general's seal and returned to Hanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: When Yongning fell again and Renhuai could not be held, Liangdong accused Wu Dan of failing to hurry to the rescue; he surrendered his general's seal and withdrew to Hanzhong.

sentences.zh: 事定，還京，王大臣等議罪，奪職。

translations.literal: When affairs were settled he returned to the capital; the princes and ministers deliberated on his offenses and stripped him of office.
translations.idiomatic: After the campaign he returned to the capital, where the princes and ministers judged his faults and removed him from office.

sentences.zh: 尋授三等侍衛兼佐領。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward he was appointed third-class imperial guard and assistant commandant.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon made a third-class imperial guard and assistant commandant.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，喀爾喀台吉額爾克阿海等為亂，噶爾丹亦犯邊，命從大將軍裕親王討之，戰於烏闌布通，噶爾丹敗走。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year the Khalkha taiji Erke Ahai and others stirred rebellion, Galdan also violated the frontier; he was ordered to follow Grand General Prince Yu in suppressing them, fought at Ulan Butong, and Galdan was defeated and fled.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year, when the Khalkha taiji Erke Ahai and others rose in revolt and Galdan also raided the border, Wu Dan was ordered to serve under Grand General Prince Yu against them; at Ulan Butong Galdan was routed and fled.

sentences.zh: 裕親王命吳丹與參領色爾濟、博爾和岱詗噶爾丹所在，知遠去已數日，乃還。

translations.literal: Prince Yu ordered Wu Dan together with company commander Serji and Borhodei to scout where Galdan was; learning that he had fled several days before, they returned.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Yu sent Wu Dan with company commanders Serji and Borhodei to reconnoiter Galdan's whereabouts; finding that he had been gone for days, they turned back.

sentences.zh: 途值喀爾喀叛者，並遇害，贈散秩大臣，予拖沙喇哈番世職。

translations.literal: On the way they encountered Khalkha rebels and were both killed; he was posthumously granted minister without portfolio and given a hereditary captaincy.
translations.idiomatic: On the return march they met Khalkha rebels and were killed; Wu Dan was posthumously honored as minister without portfolio and his heirs received a captaincy.

sentences.zh: 畢力克圖，博爾濟吉特氏，蒙古正藍旗人，世居科爾沁。

translations.literal: Biliketu, of the Borjigit clan, was a Mongol of the Plain Blue Banner whose family had long lived in Khorchin.
translations.idiomatic: Biliketu, of the Borjigit clan, belonged to the Plain Blue Banner Mongols and his family had long been settled in Khorchin.

sentences.zh: 太宗時，來歸，授豫親王護衛。

translations.literal: In the Taizong reign he came over in submission and was appointed guard to Prince of Yu.
translations.idiomatic: During the Taizong reign he submitted to the dynasty and was made a guard to Prince of Yu.

sentences.zh: 從伐朝鮮及明錦州，並有功。

translations.literal: Following campaigns against Korea and against Ming at Jinzhou, he distinguished himself in both.
translations.idiomatic: He served in campaigns against Korea and against Ming at Jinzhou and won merit in both.

sentences.zh: 順治初，從討李自成，定西安，移師拔揚州，下江寧，以戰績著，署護軍統領，予牛錄章京世職，擢正藍旗蒙古副都統。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Shunzhi he followed the campaign against Li Zicheng, settled Xi'an, shifted the army to take Yangzhou and capture Jiangning; noted for his battle record, he was appointed acting commander of the Guards, granted the hereditary rank of company commander, and promoted to Mongol deputy lieutenant-general of the Plain Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: In early Shunzhi he marched against Li Zicheng, helped secure Xi'an, then turned south to take Yangzhou and Jiangning; distinguished in battle, he was named acting commander of the Guards, granted a hereditary company commandership, and raised to Mongol deputy lieutenant-general of the Plain Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 六年，詔駐防平陽，賊犯絳州，擊卻之。

translations.literal: In the sixth year an edict ordered him garrisoned at Pingyang; when bandits invaded Jiangzhou he attacked and repulsed them.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he was ordered to garrison Pingyang; when rebels struck Jiangzhou he drove them back.

sentences.zh: 李建泰叛據太平，復與協領根特等攻之，久弗下，乃穴地燃火藥隳城，擒建泰誅之。

translations.literal: Li Jiantai rebelled and held Taiping; he again joined assistant commandant Gente and others in attacking it; it long could not be taken, so they tunneled under the ground, ignited gunpowder, and destroyed the wall, captured Jiantai, and executed him.
translations.idiomatic: When Li Jiantai rebelled and seized Taiping, Biliketu again joined assistant commandant Gente and others in the assault; after a long stalemate they dug a mine, blasted the walls with gunpowder, captured Jiantai, and put him to death.

sentences.zh: 累進一等阿達哈哈番。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to first-class commandant.
translations.idiomatic: He rose in stages to first-class commandant.

sentences.zh: 授禮部侍郎，調戶部。

translations.literal: He was appointed vice minister of Rites and transferred to the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: He was made vice minister of Rites and then transferred to the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 十一年，從靖南將軍珠瑪喇下廣東，明將李定國犯新會，屯縣左山峪。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he followed Pacification General of the South Zhumala south into Guangdong; the Ming general Li Dingguo invaded Xinhui and encamped at Zuoshanyu in the county.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he marched with Pacification General of the South Zhumala into Guangdong; when the Ming general Li Dingguo struck Xinhui, the rebels encamped at Zuoshanyu in the county.

sentences.zh: 畢力克圖再戰敗之，追至興業，斬殺過半，趨橫州，定國渡江遁。

translations.literal: Biliketu again fought and defeated him, pursued to Xingye, killed more than half, pressed toward Hengzhou, and Dingguo crossed the river and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Biliketu defeated him again, pursued to Xingye and killed more than half his force, then pressed on toward Hengzhou until Dingguo fled across the river.

sentences.zh: 進三等阿思哈尼哈番。

translations.literal: He was advanced to third-class commandant-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to third-class commandant-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 坐事罷官，降二等阿達哈哈番。

translations.literal: For an offense he was dismissed from office and reduced to second-class commandant.
translations.idiomatic: Censured for misconduct, he was removed from office and demoted to second-class commandant.

sentences.zh: 十七年，命署護軍統領。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year he was ordered to act as commander of the Guards.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year he was appointed acting commander of the Guards.

sentences.zh: 從定西將軍愛星阿出師雲南。

translations.literal: He followed Pacification General of the West Aisingga in an expedition into Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: He served under Pacification General of the West Aisingga on the Yunnan campaign.

sentences.zh: 時明桂王入緬甸，定國與白文選分據孟艮、木邦。

translations.literal: At that time the Ming Prince of Gui had entered Burma; Dingguo and Bai Wenxuan held Menggen and Mubang respectively.
translations.idiomatic: The Ming Prince of Gui had already entered Burma; Dingguo and Bai Wenxuan held Menggen and Mubang respectively.

sentences.zh: 十八年，會師木邦，定國走景線，文選走錫箔江，毀橋趨茶山。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year the armies joined at Mubang; Dingguo fled to Jingxian, Wenxuan fled to Xibo River, destroyed the bridge, and made for Chashan.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year the armies converged at Mubang; Dingguo fled to Jingxian and Wenxuan fled toward the Xibo River, burning the bridge as he withdrew into the Chashan hills.

sentences.zh: 畢力克圖至，獲諜者，結筏以濟，次舊晚坡，去緬城六十里。

translations.literal: When Biliketu arrived he captured a spy, lashed rafts to cross, and halted at Jiuwanpo, sixty li from the Burmese capital.
translations.idiomatic: Biliketu arrived, took a spy, rafted across the river, and encamped at Jiuwanpo, sixty li from the Burmese capital.

sentences.zh: 緬人謀獻桂王，請大軍留駐，以百人進蘭鳩江備捍衛，於是白爾赫圖率前鋒以往，畢力克圖以護軍二百人從之。

translations.literal: The Burmese planned to hand over the Prince of Gui and asked that the main army remain in camp while a hundred men advanced to Lanjiu River for protection; thereupon Bai Erhetu led the vanguard forward and Biliketu followed with two hundred guardsmen.
translations.idiomatic: The Burmese meant to surrender the Prince of Gui and asked the main army to hold in place while a hundred men moved up to Lanjiu River as escort; Bai Erhetu took the vanguard forward, and Biliketu followed with two hundred guardsmen.

sentences.zh: 緬酋蟒猛以桂王出畀我軍，遂班師還。

translations.literal: The Burmese chief Mang Meng handed over the Prince of Gui to our army, whereupon the army withdrew and returned.
translations.idiomatic: The Burmese chief Mang Meng delivered the Prince of Gui to the Qing forces, and the army marched home.

sentences.zh: 文選至猛養，為總兵馬寧追及，率眾降。

translations.literal: Wenxuan reached Mengyang; pursued and overtaken by regional commander Ma Ning, he led his followers in surrender.
translations.idiomatic: When Wenxuan reached Mengyang, regional commander Ma Ning ran him down and he surrendered with his men.

sentences.zh: 畢力克圖撫其眾，徙之邊境。

translations.literal: Biliketu pacified his followers and moved them to the border.
translations.idiomatic: Biliketu settled his troops and resettled them on the frontier.

sentences.zh: 論功，進一等阿達哈哈番兼拖沙喇哈番。

translations.literal: In reckoning merit he was advanced to first-class commandant with captain.
translations.idiomatic: For his service he was promoted to first-class commandant with an additional captaincy.

sentences.zh: 康熙八年，擢正藍旗蒙古都統，列議政大臣。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Kangxi he was promoted to Mongol lieutenant-general of the Plain Blue Banner and enrolled among the grand councilors.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Kangxi he was made Mongol lieutenant-general of the Plain Blue Banner and given a seat among the grand councilors.

sentences.zh: 十二年，加太子少師。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he was granted the addendum title of Junior Preceptor of the Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year he received the addendum title Junior Preceptor of the Crown Prince.

sentences.zh: 十四年，王輔臣叛，授畢力克圖平逆將軍，帥師駐大同。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year Wang Fuchen rebelled; Biliketu was appointed Ping-rebel General and led troops garrisoned at Datong.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year, when Wang Fuchen rebelled, Biliketu was named Ping-rebel General and posted with an army at Datong.

sentences.zh: 尋延安、綏德皆陷，命進駐榆林。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward Yan'an and Suide both fell; he was ordered to advance and garrison Yulin.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Yan'an and Suide fell, and he was ordered forward to Yulin.

sentences.zh: 诇知賊屯楊家店渡口，遂分兵三隊，乘夜疾進。

translations.literal: Scouts reported that the rebels were encamped at the Yangjiadian crossing; he then divided his force into three columns and advanced swiftly by night.
translations.idiomatic: Learning that the rebels held the Yangjiadian ford, he split his force into three columns and pressed forward by night.

sentences.zh: 黎明，鳴角濟河。

translations.literal: At dawn he sounded horns and crossed the river.
translations.idiomatic: At daybreak horns sounded and his troops crossed the river.

sentences.zh: 賊不虞我師至也，皆駭走，遂復吳堡。

translations.literal: The rebels did not expect our army to arrive; all fled in alarm, and Wubao was recovered.
translations.idiomatic: Caught off guard, the rebels broke and ran, and Wubao was retaken.

sentences.zh: 進次虎爾崖口，遇賊，又擊敗之。

translations.literal: Advancing he halted at Hu'eryakou, encountered rebels, and again defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Pushing on to Hu'eryakou he met the rebels again and routed them.

sentences.zh: 下綏德，乘勝克延安，並招撫附近諸​​州縣。

translations.literal: He took Suide, pressed the victory to capture Yan'an, and also pacified the nearby prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: He took Suide, followed up to capture Yan'an, and brought the surrounding prefectures and counties back under control.

sentences.zh: 上命移師會揚威將軍阿密達攻平涼。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered him to shift his army and join Awesome Pacification General Amitai in attacking Pingliang.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered him to move up and join Awesome Pacification General Amitai's assault on Pingliang.

sentences.zh: 將至，輔臣擁眾迎戰，與貝勒洞鄂等擊之，陣斬其將郝天祥。

translations.literal: As they were about to arrive, Fuchen gathered his followers to meet them in battle; together with Beile Tonge and others they attacked him and beheaded his general Hao Tianxiang in the field.
translations.idiomatic: As they approached, Fuchen came out with a large force; Biliketu joined Beile Tonge and the others in the fight and cut down the rebel general Hao Tianxiang on the field.

sentences.zh: 十五年，大學士圖海蒞師，命畢力克圖屯寧夏。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year Grand Secretary Tu Hai personally took command of the army and ordered Biliketu to encamp at Ningxia.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year Grand Secretary Tu Hai took field command and posted Biliketu at Ningxia.

sentences.zh: 輔臣降，還駐平涼。

translations.literal: Fuchen surrendered, and he returned to garrison Pingliang.
translations.idiomatic: After Fuchen surrendered he withdrew to garrison Pingliang.

sentences.zh: 十七年，移師守隴州、寶雞。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year he shifted his army to hold Longzhou and Baoji.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year he moved his troops to guard Longzhou and Baoji.

sentences.zh: 圖海議取漢中，與鄂克濟哈等分道入，以次降靈臺、華亭、崇信諸縣。

translations.literal: Tu Hai planned to take Hanzhong; together with Ekjiha and others he entered by separate routes and in sequence received the surrender of Lingtai, Huating, Chongxin, and other counties.
translations.idiomatic: Tu Hai proposed the recapture of Hanzhong; Biliketu entered by a separate route with Ekjiha and the others, reducing Lingtai, Huating, Chongxin, and the other counties in turn.

sentences.zh: 其冬，克成縣。

translations.literal: That winter Chengxian was taken.
translations.idiomatic: That winter Chengxian fell.

sentences.zh: 十九年，徵還，仍任都統。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year he was recalled and again held the post of lieutenant-general.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year he was recalled and resumed his post as lieutenant-general.

sentences.zh: 二十年，卒，年七十有三，諡恪僖。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year he died at the age of seventy-three; his posthumous title was Keji.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the twentieth year at seventy-three and was given the posthumous title Keji.

sentences.zh: 孫常遠，襲職。

translations.literal: His grandson Changyuan inherited the office.
translations.idiomatic: His grandson Changyuan succeeded to the hereditary post.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，追錄陝西軍功，進二等阿思哈尼哈番。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year past service in Shaanxi was posthumously recorded and he was advanced to second-class commandant-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year his Shaanxi campaign honors were recorded posthumously and he was raised to second-class commandant-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 噶爾漢，納喇氏，滿洲正紅旗人，尚書噶達渾子也。

translations.literal: Garhan, of the Nara clan, was a Manchu of the Plain Red Banner and the son of Minister Gadahun.
translations.idiomatic: Garhan, of the Nara clan, belonged to the Plain Red Banner and was the son of Minister Gadahun.

sentences.zh: 噶爾漢襲一等阿達哈哈番，授王府長史。

translations.literal: Garhan inherited the first-class commandantcy and was appointed secretary of the princely mansion.
translations.idiomatic: Garhan succeeded to a first-class commandantcy and was named secretary of the princely mansion.

sentences.zh: 康熙初，遷正紅旗滿洲副都統。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Kangxi he was transferred to Manchu deputy lieutenant-general of the Plain Red Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Kangxi he was made Manchu deputy lieutenant-general of the Plain Red Banner.

sentences.zh: 十四年，授鎮安將軍，駐守河南。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year he was appointed General Who Pacifies An and garrisoned Henan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year he was named General Who Pacifies An and posted to Henan.

sentences.zh: 時寇勢甚熾，總兵楊來嘉叛，命移師襄陽。

translations.literal: At that time the bandit forces were very strong; regional commander Yang Laijia rebelled, and he was ordered to shift his army to Xiangyang.
translations.idiomatic: Bandit power was then at its height; regional commander Yang Laijia rose in rebellion, and Garhan was ordered to move his forces to Xiangyang.

sentences.zh: 十五年，戰南漳，破靈機寨。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year he fought at Nanzhang and stormed Lingji Stockade.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year he fought at Nanzhang and took Lingji Stockade.

sentences.zh: 叛將譚弘等犯鄖陽，遣黨扼城東陡嶺，斷我輓運道。

translations.literal: Rebel general Tan Hong and others attacked Yunyang, sent followers to hold Steep Ridge east of the city, and cut our supply routes.
translations.idiomatic: Rebel general Tan Hong and others struck at Yunyang, posted men on Steep Ridge east of the city, and severed our supply lines.

sentences.zh: 復與提督佟國瑤會師，分路進擊，賊退。

translations.literal: He again joined forces with provincial commander-in-chief Tong Guoyao, attacked by separate routes, and the bandits withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: He joined provincial commander-in-chief Tong Guoyao, and their columns advanced by separate routes until the bandits fell back.

sentences.zh: 十八年，謝泗、劉魁等掠竹山、竹谿諸縣，偪鄖城，與興安賊為聲援，噶爾漢往討之。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year Xie Si, Liu Kui, and others plundered Zhushan, Zhuxi, and other counties, pressed on Yuncheng, and coordinated with the bandits at Xing'an; Garhan went to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year Xie Si, Liu Kui, and others raided Zhushan, Zhuxi, and neighboring counties, closed on Yuncheng, and acted in concert with the rebels at Xing'an; Garhan marched out against them.

sentences.zh: 時方溽暑，鄖西數百里，山迳★C7隘，草木叢塞，霪雨洪注，師阻水，弗能進。

translations.literal: It was then the height of summer; for several hundred li west of Yunyang the mountain paths were narrow, vegetation thickly choked the ways, torrential rains poured down, the army was blocked by water, and could not advance.
translations.idiomatic: It was the height of summer; for hundreds of li west of Yunyang the mountain tracks were narrow and overgrown, torrential rains had swollen every stream, and the army could not get forward.

sentences.zh: 噶爾漢期以木落水涸時進師，上責其逗留，削前功。

translations.literal: Garhan fixed on advancing when the trees shed their leaves and the waters dried, but the emperor blamed him for tarrying and stripped him of his earlier merits.
translations.idiomatic: Garhan planned to advance only after the autumn leaf-fall and the drying of the streams; the emperor rebuked him for delay and cancelled his earlier honors.

sentences.zh: 二十年，薄鄖城，時弘已死，其子天秘毀壘遁，遂克之。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year he pressed on Yuncheng; by then Hong was dead, and his son Tianmi destroyed the fortifications and fled, so the city was taken.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year he closed on Yuncheng; Tan Hong was already dead, and his son Tianmi demolished the defenses and fled, so the city fell.

sentences.zh: 以次下萬、開、建始、梁山諸縣及忠州。

translations.literal: In succession he reduced Wan, Kai, Jianshi, Liangshan, and other counties, as well as Zhongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He then took Wan, Kai, Jianshi, Liangshan, and the other counties in turn, along with Zhongzhou.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，授荊州將軍。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year he was appointed Jingzhou general.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year he was named Jingzhou general.

sentences.zh: 部議當楊來嘉攻房縣不能救，當奪職，上命降級留任。

translations.literal: The ministry deliberated that when Yang Laijia attacked Fang County he had been unable to rescue it and his office should be stripped; the emperor ordered a demotion while retaining him in post.
translations.idiomatic: The ministry held that he deserved dismissal for failing to relieve Fang County when Yang Laijia attacked it, but the emperor demoted him while keeping him in office.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，湖廣裁兵，夏逢龍倡亂。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year troops were cut in Huguang, and Xia Fenglong raised rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year Huguang underwent troop reductions, and Xia Fenglong led a revolt.

sentences.zh: 噶爾漢師次安陸，遣協領穆禮瑪等攻之，多所斬馘。

translations.literal: Garhan's army halted at Anlu; he sent assistant commandant Mulima and others to attack them and beheaded many.
translations.idiomatic: Garhan's army encamped at Anlu and sent assistant commandant Mulima and others against the rebels, who suffered heavy losses.

sentences.zh: 進次應城，賊還竄武昌，會糧絕，戰艦不足用，疏言狀，召還，授正紅旗蒙古都統。

translations.literal: Advancing to Yingcheng, the bandits fled back toward Wuchang; but supplies ran out and warships proved insufficient; he memorialized explaining the situation, was recalled, and was appointed Mongol commander-in-chief of the Plain Red Banner.
translations.idiomatic: He pushed on to Yingcheng as the bandits fell back toward Wuchang, but supplies gave out and his warships were inadequate; after memorializing the situation he was recalled and made Mongol commander-in-chief of the Plain Red Banner.

sentences.zh: 比至都，論退縮玩寇罪，免官。

translations.literal: When he reached the capital, he was judged guilty of retreat and slack pursuit of the bandits and was dismissed from office.
translations.idiomatic: On reaching the capital he was convicted of retreating and failing to press the rebels and was stripped of office.

sentences.zh: 後卒於家。

translations.literal: He later died at home.
translations.idiomatic: He later died at home.

sentences.zh: 阿密達，他塔喇氏，滿洲正白旗人。

translations.literal: Amitai, of the Tatara clan, was a Manchu of the Plain White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Amitai, of the Tatara clan, belonged to the Plain White Banner.

sentences.zh: 順治間，授三等侍衛，洊擢正白旗滿洲副都統。

translations.literal: During Shunzhi he was appointed a third-class imperial guard and was successively promoted to Manchu deputy lieutenant-general of the Plain White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Under Shunzhi he entered service as a third-class imperial guard and rose in stages to Manchu deputy lieutenant-general of the Plain White Banner.

sentences.zh: 康熙初，擢領侍衛內大臣、議政大臣。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Kangxi he was promoted to senior imperial bodyguard and privy councillor.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Kangxi he was raised to senior imperial bodyguard and privy councillor.

sentences.zh: 十三年，吳三桂反，襄陽總兵楊來嘉以穀城叛應之。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year Wu Sangui rebelled; Xiangyang regional commander Yang Laijia rebelled at Gucheng in response.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year Wu Sangui rose in rebellion, and Xiangyang regional commander Yang Laijia mutinied at Gucheng to join him.

sentences.zh: 河北總兵蔡祿初與來嘉並為鄭成功將，先後來降。

translations.literal: Hebei regional commander Cai Lu had originally served under Zheng Chenggong alongside Laijia and had surrendered in turn.
translations.idiomatic: Hebei regional commander Cai Lu had once served Zheng Chenggong together with Laijia and had surrendered in turn.

sentences.zh: 來嘉招同叛，祿具槍械，購騾馬，密令所部為備。

translations.literal: Laijia invited him to rebel together; Lu gathered firearms, bought mules, and secretly ordered his troops to prepare.
translations.idiomatic: Laijia urged him to join the rebellion; Lu stockpiled firearms, bought pack mules, and secretly put his command on alert.

sentences.zh: 聖祖聞狀，命阿密達率兵赴懷慶察視，祿不出迎，謀拒戰。

translations.literal: The Sage Ancestor learned of the situation and ordered Amitai to lead troops to Huaiqing to investigate; Lu did not come out to welcome him and plotted resistance.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor learned what was afoot, he sent Amitai with troops to Huaiqing to investigate; Cai Lu refused to come out and prepared to resist.

sentences.zh: 阿密達疾馳入其廨，得祿及其孥，悉誅之。

translations.literal: Amitai galloped into his yamen, seized Lu and his family, and executed them all.
translations.idiomatic: Amitai rode straight into Cai Lu's headquarters, seized him and his family, and put them all to death.

sentences.zh: 耿精忠亦叛，授阿密達揚威將軍，率滿洲兵千人駐江寧，命習水戰。

translations.literal: Geng Jingzhong also rebelled; Amitai was appointed General Who Displays Might, led a thousand Manchu troops to garrison Jiangning, and was ordered to train in naval warfare.
translations.idiomatic: When Geng Jingzhong also rebelled, Amitai was named General Who Displays Might, took a thousand Manchu troops to garrison Jiangning, and was ordered to drill in naval warfare.

sentences.zh: 尋授簡親王喇布揚威大將軍，阿密達歸將軍印，參贊軍務。

translations.literal: Soon Prince Jian Labu was appointed Grand General Who Displays Might; Amitai returned the general's seal and assisted in military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward Prince Jian Labu was made Grand General Who Displays Might; Amitai surrendered the general's seal and served on his staff.

sentences.zh: 王輔臣叛，十四年，命阿密達仍佩揚威將軍印，率兵赴蘭州，佐以副都統鄂克濟哈、覺羅誇岱。

translations.literal: When Wang Fuchen rebelled, in the fourteenth year Amitai was ordered again to bear the seal of General Who Displays Might, lead troops to Lanzhou, and be assisted by deputy lieutenant-generals Ekejeha and Kuodai of the Aisin Gioro clan.
translations.idiomatic: When Wang Fuchen rebelled, Amitai was again given the seal of General Who Displays Might in the fourteenth year and sent to Lanzhou with deputy lieutenant-generals Ekejeha and the Aisin Gioro Kuodai to assist him.

sentences.zh: 時輔臣據平涼，蘭州諸路皆陷賊，大將軍貝勒洞鄂令阿密達徑攻平涼。

translations.literal: At that time Fuchen held Pingliang and the routes around Lanzhou had all fallen to the bandits; Grand General Beile Tonge ordered Amitai to attack Pingliang directly.
translations.idiomatic: Fuchen then held Pingliang while the routes around Lanzhou had fallen to the rebels; Grand General Beile Tonge ordered Amitai to strike Pingliang head-on.

sentences.zh: 五月，克寧州，薄平涼，戰失利，退駐涇州。

translations.literal: In the fifth month he took Ningzhou and pressed on Pingliang, but the battle went against him and he withdrew to encamp at Jing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month he captured Ningzhou and closed on Pingliang, but after a defeat he fell back to Jing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 洞鄂兵至，命參贊軍務，與總兵孫思克會師進攻，久不下。

translations.literal: When Tonge's army arrived, Amitai was ordered to assist in military affairs; he joined regional commander Sun Sike and advanced together, but the city long could not be taken.
translations.idiomatic: When Tonge's forces arrived, Amitai was placed on the staff and joined regional commander Sun Sike in a combined assault, yet the city held out for a long time.

sentences.zh: 十五年，大學士圖海代為大將軍，阿密達參贊如故。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year Grand Secretary Tu Hai replaced him as grand general; Amitai continued to assist in military affairs as before.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year Grand Secretary Tu Hai succeeded him as grand general, and Amitai remained on the staff as before.

sentences.zh: 既，奪虎山墩，俯攻城，輔臣乃降。

translations.literal: Thereafter they seized Tiger Mountain Redoubt and attacked the city from above; Fuchen then surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: They then took Tiger Mountain Redoubt and pressed the assault from the heights, and Fuchen submitted.

sentences.zh: 十七年，命赴湖南，從大將軍安親王岳樂討吳世璠。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year he was ordered to go to Hunan and follow Grand General Prince An Yuele in suppressing Wu Shifan.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year he was sent to Hunan to serve under Grand General Prince An Yuele against Wu Shifan.

sentences.zh: 十八年，克武岡。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year he took Wugang.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year Wugang fell to his forces.

sentences.zh: 諭阿密達與安親王計議，量撤滿洲兵，護還京師。

translations.literal: The emperor instructed Amitai and Prince An to consult together, withdraw Manchu troops as appropriate, and escort them back to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor directed Amitai and Prince An to consult on withdrawing Manchu troops as circumstances allowed and escorting them back to the capital.

sentences.zh: 十九年，授正白旗蒙古都統。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year he was appointed Mongol commander-in-chief of the Plain White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year he was made Mongol commander-in-chief of the Plain White Banner.

sentences.zh: 部議平涼戰敗當奪職，上寬之，命降五級留任。

translations.literal: The ministry deliberated that for defeat at Pingliang his office should be stripped; the emperor showed leniency and ordered a demotion of five ranks while retaining him in post.
translations.idiomatic: The ministry held that he deserved dismissal for the defeat at Pingliang, but the emperor was lenient and demoted him five ranks while keeping him in office.

sentences.zh: 尋复授領侍衛內大臣。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was again appointed senior imperial bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon restored as senior imperial bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 噶爾丹為亂，命诇賊狀。

translations.literal: When Galdan raised rebellion, he was ordered to scout the bandits' situation.
translations.idiomatic: When Galdan stirred up trouble, he was sent to reconnoiter the enemy's movements.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，命參贊大將軍裕親王福全軍務，出塞討噶爾丹，戰於烏闌布通，勝敵。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year he was ordered to assist Grand General Prince Yu Fuquan in military affairs, marched beyond the frontier to suppress Galdan, fought at Ulan Butong, and defeated the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year he joined Grand General Prince Yu Fuquan's staff, marched beyond the frontier against Galdan, and routed the enemy at Ulan Butong.

sentences.zh: 師還，部議不能乘勝滅賊，福全以下皆有罪，當奪職。

translations.literal: When the army returned, the ministry deliberated that they had failed to exploit victory to destroy the bandits; Fuquan and those below were all guilty and should be stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: After the army returned, the ministry ruled that they had failed to follow up their victory and destroy the enemy; Fuquan and his subordinates were all found guilty and liable to dismissal.

sentences.zh: 上以師有功，宥之。

translations.literal: The emperor, considering that the army had achieved merit, pardoned them.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor, holding that the army had nonetheless won distinction, pardoned them.

sentences.zh: 三十五年，上親征噶爾丹，阿密達請從征。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fifth year the emperor took the field in person against Galdan; Amitai requested to follow the campaign.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor marched in person against Galdan in the thirty-fifth year, Amitai asked to accompany the expedition.

sentences.zh: 上次克魯倫河，以阿密達暫充將軍，率留後滿洲兵及綠旗步兵赴克勒和碩，並命兼轄留屯各軍。

translations.literal: When the emperor next crossed the Kerulen River, Amitai was temporarily appointed general, led the rear-guard Manchu troops and Green Standard infantry to Keleheshuo, and was also ordered to command all garrison troops left behind.
translations.idiomatic: On the emperor's next crossing of the Kerulen River, Amitai was temporarily made general, took the rear-guard Manchu troops and Green Standard infantry to Keleheshuo, and was given overall command of the troops left in garrison.

sentences.zh: 尋撤還京師。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was withdrawn back to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon recalled to the capital.

sentences.zh: 四十八年，卒。

translations.literal: In the forty-eighth year he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the forty-eighth year.

sentences.zh: 鄂克濟哈，納喇氏，滿洲正黃旗人。

translations.literal: Ekejeha, of the Nara clan, was a Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Ekejeha, of the Nara clan, belonged to the Plain Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 初任侍衛，署副都統兼佐領。

translations.literal: He first served as imperial guard, then acted as deputy lieutenant-general and company commander.
translations.idiomatic: He began as an imperial guard and later served as acting deputy lieutenant-general and company commander.

sentences.zh: 康熙十三年，三桂反，陝西、湖廣並警。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Kangxi, Wu Sangui rebelled and Shaanxi and Huguang were both alarmed.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year of Kangxi, Wu Sangui rebelled and alarm spread through Shaanxi and Huguang.

sentences.zh: 上命偕副​​統色格駐河南府。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered him to go together with deputy lieutenant-general Sege to garrison Henan prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered him and deputy lieutenant-general Sege to garrison Henan prefecture together.

sentences.zh: 輔臣亂起，從阿密達赴西安剿禦。

translations.literal: When Fuchen's rebellion broke out, he followed Amida to Xi'an to suppress and defend against the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: When Fuchen rebelled, he marched with Amida to Xi'an to put down the uprising.

sentences.zh: 尋赴蘭州參贊阿密達軍務，克涇州、寧州，詔嘉之。

translations.literal: Soon he went to Lanzhou to assist in Amida's military affairs, captured Jingzhou and Ningzhou, and an edict praised him.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon sent to Lanzhou on Amida's staff, captured Jingzhou and Ningzhou, and received an edict of commendation.

sentences.zh: 十八年，從圖海攻禮縣驛門，大破之。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year he followed Tu Hai in attacking the Yimen post station at Li County and inflicted a great defeat.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year he followed Tu Hai against the Yimen pass at Li County and routed the enemy.

sentences.zh: 复塔什堡，進克興安。

translations.literal: He again recovered Tashibao and advanced to capture Xing'an.
translations.idiomatic: He retook Tashibao and pressed on to capture Xing'an.

sentences.zh: 圖海以漢中要地，令鄂克濟哈領振武將軍，與副都統哈塔將千人守之。

translations.literal: Tu Hai, because Hanzhong was a vital position, appointed Ekjiha General Who Shakes Martial prowess, with Deputy Lieutenant-General Hata leading a thousand men to hold it.
translations.idiomatic: Tu Hai judged Hanzhong a key strongpoint and made Ekjiha General Who Shakes Martial prowess, posting Deputy Lieutenant-General Hata and a thousand troops to hold it.

sentences.zh: 十九年，提督趙良棟等徇四川，與將軍吳丹為後勁。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year, as Provincial Military Commissioner Zhao Liangdong and others campaigned in Sichuan, he served with General Wu Dan as the rear echelon.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year, when Provincial Military Commissioner Zhao Liangdong advanced into Sichuan, Ekjiha served with General Wu Dan on the rear echelon.

sentences.zh: 瀘州陷，率師攻克之，又敗之託川雅。

translations.literal: Luzhou fell; he led troops to recapture it and again defeated the enemy at Tuochuan and Ya.
translations.idiomatic: After Luzhou fell he led troops to retake it, then beat the rebels again at Tuochuan and Ya.

sentences.zh: 未幾，賊犯仁懷，吳丹擁兵不救，永寧复陷。

translations.literal: Before long the rebels attacked Renhuai; Wu Dan held his troops back and did not relieve the city, and Yongning again fell.
translations.idiomatic: Soon the rebels struck Renhuai; Wu Dan kept his force idle and failed to relieve the city, and Yongning fell once more.

sentences.zh: 命還漢中，而使鄂克濟哈領其眾。

translations.literal: Wu Dan was ordered back to Hanzhong, and Ekjiha was given command of his troops.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Dan was recalled to Hanzhong and his army was turned over to Ekjiha.

sentences.zh: 鄂克濟哈疏言建昌、永寧相去千餘裡，未能兼顧，乃命佛尼埒專領永寧一路，而授鄂克濟哈宣威將軍，駐軍成都，專領建昌一路。

translations.literal: Ekjiha memorialized that Jianchang and Yongning were more than a thousand li apart and could not both be held; Fonilie was then assigned exclusively to the Yongning route, while Ekjiha was made General Who Proclaims Might, garrisoned at Chengdu, and assigned exclusively to the Jianchang route.
translations.idiomatic: Ekjiha pointed out that Jianchang and Yongning lay more than a thousand li apart and were impossible to hold at once. Fonilie was put in charge of the Yongning line, Ekjiha was named General Who Proclaims Might with headquarters at Chengdu, and each took sole responsibility for one route.

sentences.zh: 二十年，建昌軍棄城走，自劾，解將軍印，以都統覺羅吉哈里代，還守漢中。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year the Jianchang garrison abandoned the city and fled; he impeached himself, surrendered the general's seal, and the lieutenant-general Jueluo Jihari replaced him; he returned to guard Hanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year his Jianchang garrison broke and fled the city. He submitted a self-accusation and surrendered the general's seal; Jueluo Jihari replaced him, and he went back to hold Hanzhong.

sentences.zh: 尋入為二等侍衛。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he entered service as a second-class imperial guard.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon recalled to court as a second-class imperial guard.

sentences.zh: 三十年，遷正黃旗副都統。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year he was transferred to be Manchu deputy lieutenant-general of the Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirtieth year he became Manchu deputy lieutenant-general of the Plain Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 三十三年，授護軍統領。

translations.literal: In the thirty-third year he was appointed commandant of the guards.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-third year he was made commandant of the guards.

sentences.zh: 從征噶爾丹，事平，駐守寧夏。

translations.literal: He campaigned against Galdan; when the affair was settled he garrisoned Ningxia.
translations.idiomatic: He marched against Galdan, and after peace was restored he was posted at Ningxia.

sentences.zh: 三十八年，卒。

translations.literal: In the thirty-eighth year he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the thirty-eighth year.

sentences.zh: 覺羅吉哈里，滿洲正白旗人，武功郡王禮敦第三世孫。

translations.literal: Jueluo Jihari was a Manchu of the Plain White Banner and the third-generation descendant of Prince of Wugong Lidun.
translations.idiomatic: Jueluo Jihari, a Plain White Banner Manchu, was a third-generation descendant of Prince of Wugong Lidun.

sentences.zh: 順治初，授牛錄額真，襲父拜他喇布勒哈番世職。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Shunzhi he was appointed company commander and inherited his father's hereditary rank of deputy company commander.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Shunzhi he was appointed company commander and inherited his father's hereditary rank of deputy company commander.

sentences.zh: 遇恩詔，晉二等阿達哈哈番。

translations.literal: On receiving a grace edict he was advanced to second-class hereditary commandant.
translations.idiomatic: An imperial grace edict raised his hereditary rank to second-class commandant.

sentences.zh: 累遷護軍參領、鑲黃旗滿洲副都統。

translations.literal: He was promoted in succession to vanguard commandant and Manchu deputy lieutenant-general of the Bordered Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: He rose in turn to vanguard commandant and Manchu deputy lieutenant-general of the Bordered Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 康熙十二年，吳三桂反，京師奸民楊啟隆為亂，都統圖海、祖承烈及吉哈里討平之。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Kangxi, when Wu Sangui rebelled, the scoundrel Yang Qilong stirred disorder in the capital; the lieutenant-generals Tu Hai and Zu Chengli together with Jihari suppressed it.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year of Kangxi, when Wu Sangui rebelled, the Beijing agitator Yang Qilong launched a disturbance; Lieutenant-generals Tu Hai and Zu Chengli, with Jihari, put it down.

sentences.zh: 佐領鄂克遜擒其黨黃吉、陳益，吉哈里亦獲焦三、硃尚賢、張大、李柱、陳繼志、史國賓、王鎮邦等送法司，廉得實，論棄市。

translations.literal: Company commander Ekexun captured his partisans Huang Ji and Chen Yi; Jihari also captured Jiao San, Zhu Shangxian, Zhang Da, Li Zhu, Chen Jizhi, Shi Guobin, Wang Zhenbang, and others, sent them to the judicial offices, an investigation established the facts, and they were sentenced to public execution.
translations.idiomatic: Company commander Ekexun seized the ringleaders Huang Ji and Chen Yi; Jihari also took Jiao San, Zhu Shangxian, Zhang Da, Li Zhu, Chen Jizhi, Shi Guobin, Wang Zhenbang, and the rest, handed them to the judiciary, and after inquiry confirmed their guilt they were executed at the public market.

sentences.zh: 語互詳鄂克遜傳。

translations.literal: The account is given in full in Ekexun's biography.
translations.idiomatic: For the full account see Ekexun's biography.

sentences.zh: 十六年，命與副都統席布率師赴四川會鎮安將軍噶爾漢討賊，即軍前擢鑲黃旗蒙古都統。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he was ordered to go with Deputy Lieutenant-General Xibu to lead troops to Sichuan and join Pacification General of Zhen'an Galerhan in suppressing the rebels, and on campaign he was at once promoted to Mongol deputy lieutenant-general of the Bordered Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year he and Deputy Lieutenant-General Xibu were sent into Sichuan to join Pacification General of Zhen'an Galerhan against the rebels, and on the march he was raised to Mongol deputy lieutenant-general of the Bordered Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 三桂孫吳世璠尚據有雲南、貴州，其將胡國柱、夏國相、馬寶等分犯瀘州、敘州、建昌。

translations.literal: Wu Sangui's grandson Wu Shifan still held Yunnan and Guizhou; his generals Hu Guozhu, Xia Guoxiang, and Ma Bao and others attacked Luzhou, Xuzhou, and Jianchang in separate columns.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Sangui's grandson Wu Shifan still held Yunnan and Guizhou, while his generals Hu Guozhu, Xia Guoxiang, Ma Bao, and others struck Luzhou, Xuzhou, and Jianchang on separate axes.

sentences.zh: 二十年，建昌陷，上解鄂克濟哈宣威將軍任，詔吉哈里代之，統所部兵會提督趙良棟復建昌。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year Jianchang fell; the emperor removed Ekjiha from the post of General Who Proclaims Might and ordered Jihari to replace him, commanding his troops to join Provincial Military Commissioner Zhao Liangdong in recovering Jianchang.
translations.idiomatic: When Jianchang fell in the twentieth year, the emperor relieved Ekjiha of the General Who Proclaims Might command and named Jihari in his place to lead the same force with Provincial Military Commissioner Zhao Liangdong in retaking the city.

sentences.zh: 良棟自雅州入，吉哈里為後，鏖戰大渡河，奪寇舟以濟。

translations.literal: Liangdong entered from Yazhou with Jihari bringing up the rear; they fought fiercely at the Dadu River and seized the rebels' boats to cross.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Liangdong entered from Yazhou with Jihari on the rear echelon; after a hard fight at the Dadu River they seized rebel boats and forced a crossing.

sentences.zh: 是時師下雲南，已合圍，國柱等亟引眾還，吉哈里遂復建昌。

translations.literal: At that time the armies descending on Yunnan had already closed the encirclement; Guozhu and the others hurriedly led their troops back, and Jihari thus recovered Jianchang.
translations.idiomatic: By then the columns pressing into Yunnan had closed the ring; Hu Guozhu and his fellows raced back with their armies, and Jihari retook Jianchang.

sentences.zh: 將趨雲南，行至武家，疾作，卒於軍，卹如例。

translations.literal: About to march toward Yunnan, he reached Wujia, an illness struck, and he died in camp; condolences were paid according to regulation.
translations.idiomatic: He was starting toward Yunnan when, at Wujia, illness seized him and he died in camp; the court granted the customary posthumous honors.

sentences.zh: 拉哈達，鈕祜祿氏，滿洲鑲黃旗人，車爾格第五子。

translations.literal: Lahada, of the Niohuru clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered Yellow Banner and the fifth son of Cergen.
translations.idiomatic: Lahada, of the Niohuru clan, was a Bordered Yellow Banner Manchu and the fifth son of Cergen.

sentences.zh: 順治間，以侍衛襲其兄法固達三等阿達哈哈番世職，恩詔累進一等。

translations.literal: During Shunzhi, as an imperial guard he inherited his elder brother Faguda's third-class hereditary commandantship; successive grace edicts advanced it to the first class.
translations.idiomatic: Under Shunzhi he inherited from his elder brother Faguda, as an imperial guard, a third-class hereditary commandantship, and successive grace edicts raised it to the first class.

sentences.zh: 授兵部督捕侍郎，擢工部尚書、議政大臣。

translations.literal: He was appointed vice minister of the Board of War in charge of apprehending bandits, then promoted to minister of the Board of Works and councilor of state.
translations.idiomatic: He was made vice minister of War in charge of apprehending bandits, then minister of Works and councilor of state.

sentences.zh: 康熙八年，授鑲黃旗滿洲都統。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Kangxi he was appointed Manchu deputy lieutenant-general of the Bordered Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Kangxi he became Manchu deputy lieutenant-general of the Bordered Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 十三年，吳三桂叛，授鎮東將軍，駐防兗州，甫至，而耿精忠叛，犯浙江。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year Wu Sangui rebelled; he was appointed General Who Pacifies the East and garrisoned at Yanzhou; he had barely arrived when Geng Jingzhong rebelled and invaded Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year, when Wu Sangui rebelled, he was named General Who Pacifies the East and posted at Yanzhou. He had hardly arrived when Geng Jingzhong rose as well and struck Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 詔往署杭州將軍，與平南將軍賚塔、總督李之芳共籌防禦。

translations.literal: An edict ordered him to proceed to Hangzhou to act as general and, with Pacification General of the South Laita and Governor Li Zhifang, jointly plan the defense.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered him to Hangzhou as acting general to map the defenses with Pacification General of the South Laita and Governor Li Zhifang.

sentences.zh: 賊窺金華，遣副都統沃申、副將陳世凱等擊卻之；
